Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Inspect the image first and mark only straight bond lines between non-hydrogen atoms/groups. Ignore the curved arrows and the plus/minus charge symbols. Count the visible heavy-atom connections one by one: the single bond from R to carbonyl carbon, the carbonyl C=O double bond, the single bond from carbonyl carbon to N, the double bond between the first and second N, and the double bond between the second and terminal N. This gives a total of 5 bonds.
